description: This file implements a GStreamer source element class 'GstSrc' for the Rialto media framework, including methods for setup, configuration, message handling, and state changes, as well as factory methods for creating and managing instances of the source element.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: A class implementing a GStreamer source element for Rialto, managing setup, configuration, message handling, and state transitions.

methods.name: initSrc
methods.description: Initializes the source element, registering it if not already registered.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds an app source, optional decryptor, payloader, and buffer queue to the source element.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Indicates that all app sources have been added, triggers async done handling.

methods.name: createPayloader
methods.description: Creates a payloader element, specifically 'svppay', if available.
